whatToDo: Stop the conversation. Do not send more money, codes, or remote-access access.
Verify through a number or website you look up yourself — never one they provided.
Report it at reportfraud.ftc.gov. If money moved, call your bank or card issuer now.
simpleWhatToDo: Stop talking to them. Do not send money, gift cards, or codes.
Do not call a number they gave you. Use a number from your statement, a bill, or a trusted person.
Tell a family member, friend, or the real company. Then report it at reportfraud.ftc.gov.
